_comment: Boards the pump serves; copy to boards.json and edit by hand.
Each board needs name, repo (the repo top level, with .deviz/tasks/),
"pump2": true (boards without it are skipped) and a test command
(pump2_test, or test): merge and pump2 doctor refuse a board without one.
Every other key is optional; the full table is in docs/pump.md.
